arts.ttl: Silva wants Fulham to ‘battle’ at Spurs
arts.sum: Marco Silva has demanded Fulham show more fight on the road as they prepare to face Tottenham Hotspur in another London derby on Saturday evening. The Whites have not yet won a Premier League fixture away from home this season and were easily beaten by Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium before the international break. […]

arts.ttl: Spurs missing eight players for Fulham clash
arts.sum: Spurs boss Thomas Frank confirmed that none of his injured players will be fit in time for the visit of Fulham in the Premier League this weekend.
